name: Bad Luck
overview: Scripture reveals that what some may perceive as 'bad luck' is ultimately under the sovereign hand of the LORD, who blesses those who faithfully meditate on His Word and walk uprightly. Joshua 1:8 promises prosperity and success to those who diligently observe God's law, while Psalms 84:11 assures that God withholds no good thing from the righteous. Even in adversity, as described in Psalms 35:15, God's saving strength is available to His anointed (Psalm 20:6), and His protection and grace are steadfast (Deuteronomy 28:10; Psalms 118:17). Thus, true security and blessing come not from chance but from trusting and obeying God.
